title: PermutationLehmer: Agda code for the finite permutations pearl
description: Agda code accompanying the functional pearl "niFite semPurtatoni" (Finite permutations in Agda), submitted to the Journal of Functional Programming. A first-order (Lehmer-code) representation of finite permutations with identity, composition, inversion, and a decision procedure, all proved correct.

creators.name: Jansson, Patrik
